note: Triennial election of the rural district council (ten electoral divisions), 1924; nominations received by W. J. Corner, clerk, 30 April 1924. The retiring members were returned unopposed, all Unionists. No nominations for Cornakinnegar, Montiaghs, Portadown Rural and Tartaraghan. Returned unopposed.
